Sarvam appoints former Google exec Sashikumar Sreedharan Prez and CBO press trust of india New Delhi, 9 November Indian artiﬁcial intelligence (AI) ﬁrm Sarvam on Monday announced that Sashikumar Sreedharan (pictured), most recently Managing Director for India at Google Cloud, has joined as President and Chief Business Officer. He will also join the company’s board. Sreedharan will run Sarvam’s business across enterprises and government, and widen its work with digi- tal-native ﬁrms, developers and partners. Marketing, Finance, Forward Deployed Engineering, Service Delivery and Commercial Operations will also fall under him. “Today, we’re welcoming Sashikumar as President and Chief Business Officer and a member of our board of direc- tors. Sashi will lead our busi- ness across enterprises and government, and expand our work with digital native com- panies, developers and partners,” the ﬁrm said in a blogpost. He brings more than three decades of experience in technology businesses. Before Google Cloud, he spent over ﬁve years as Manag- ing Director leading Microsoft India’s enterprise business.  Sashikumar Sreedharan was previously MD for India at Google Cloud
